name: Keiko: Marathon preparation under persistent lower-body fatigue

source.name: Keiko
source.label: Marathon preparation under persistent lower-body fatigue
source.health_context: Fictional, pain-free, no illness or medical rehabilitation. Future adaptation and event results are unknown.
source.training_history: Four years running, two completed half marathons, three years lifting. A 3:45 marathon aspiration is negotiable and must not set current-fitness paces.
source.long_run_context: Normal leg recovery after the recent 20 km took 96 hours. Shift work has cut sleep from usual 7.5 to 5.5 hours; no pain, illness or dated recovery clearance.

mapping: Entirely new synthetic source facts authored before generation; no prescribed sessions or calendar assignments supplied.
Lift frequencies and strength visits are explicit athlete requests, not inferred from visit count.
Rep performances stay rep observations. Canonical UI estimatedMax supplies provisional loads, never a fabricated tested max.
Event permissions and whole-visit caps are explicit; no extra time, recovery clearance or readiness scores are invented.
The same canonical proposal/generator path supplies every prescription.

framework.rationale: Without a strength event, continue building rather than imposing a competition peak.
